abstract: Epignathus is an extremely rare, benign, congenital teratoma that arises from the oral cavity. When treating epignathus with cleft palate, it is particularly important to consider velopharyngeal function and maxillary growth after surgical repair. The case of an infant with a complete cleft palate and a large mass, histologically diagnosed as a mature teratoma, that protruded from the right soft palate is described. At 8 months of age, a double-opposing Z-plasty was performed using a part of the tumor over the right soft palate that had been left at the time of primary excision at 3 months of age for an epignathus protruding from the mouth. Though all that could be done was suture tumor tissue on the right side and the left hypoplastic levator veli palatine muscle using the double-opposing Z-plasty, velopharyngeal function and maxillary growth were good at 10 years of age.
abstract_ja: 口腔から発生する稀な良性先天性奇形腫であるエピグナサスは、完全口蓋裂を伴う場合、手術後の咽頭弁機能と上顎発育を特に慎重に考慮する必要がある。完全口蓋裂と、右軟口蓋から突出する大きな成熟奇形腫(組織学的に診断)を有する乳児例を報告する。生後3か月で口から突出するエピグナサスの一次切除時に残しておいた、右側軟口蓋上の腫瘍の一部を用い、生後8か月で二重対向Z形成術を施行した。右側の腫瘍組織を縫合し、左側の低形成口蓋挙筋に縫合する方法のみが可能であったが、二重対向Z形成術により、10歳時点で咽頭弁機能と上顎発育は良好であった。
